## Answer block (40-60 words, near the top)

The LTV:CAC ratio compares what a customer is worth over their lifetime with what it cost to win them. Divide gross-margin lifetime value by fully loaded acquisition cost. A ratio above 3:1 is the common SaaS guideline, but read it with payback, because a high ratio can still strain cash.
